---
title: "About"
---

I know, I know ... we are not supposed to use AI. But I used Grok a lot to build this. I used it in the same way I would use Google to track down info, 
but I did not provide it with the AoC challenges and ask for solutions. For example, in the Day 1 challenge, I came up with the idea of using some 
functionality which would allow me to cycle through vectors or lists, asked Grok for documentation and examples of what was 
available, e.g. data.table::shift, and then I worked on programming the solutions.

I used Grok far more in asking quarto-related questions in order to organize code and produce this website.

Version 0.3.5
